entities.name: Michaël Bournival
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Alain Michaël Bournival is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. He was selected in the third round, 71st overall, by the Colorado Avalanche of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the 2010 NHL Entry Draft and played for the Montreal Canadiens and Tampa Bay Lightning.
